extracted.name: Jerk Seasoning
extracted.description: This Jamaican jerk seasoning recipe makes a hot and spicy homemade spice mix with a simple blend of spices, including cayenne, cinnamon, and thyme.
instruction_lines: Stir dried onion, thyme, allspice, ground black pepper, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, and salt together in a small bowl.
